name: Alternative Syntax
description: PHP offers an alternative syntax for some of its control structures; namely, ``if``, ``while``, ``for``, ``foreach``, and ``switch``. In each case, the basic form of the alternate syntax is to change the opening brace to a colon ``:`` and the closing brace to ``endif;``, ``endwhile;``, ``endfor;``, ``endforeach;``, or ``endswitch;``, respectively.
code:
<?php if ($a == 5): ?>
A is equal to 5
<?php endif; ?>

citations.name: Using Alternative Syntax for Control Structures in PHP to Enhance HTML Integration
